title: Abductee friend grabs a gray by the neck

tellings.quote: and she actually in one of her experiences, she actually grabbed one by the neck and squeezed it before she passed out

plain: A woman who says she has been abducted by aliens once grabbed one of them by the neck and squeezed it before she passed out. The beings were grays, the small grey-skinned figures that many people who report abductions describe. The filmmaker and researcher Tim Alberino tells Michels this as something his friend told him about one of her experiences. If it were true, it would mean these beings can be touched and fought back against.
